abstract: Firms are increasingly adopting Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance productivity and eventually save costs and increase revenue. Continued LLM adoption requires that LLMs demonstrate tangible Return-on-Investment, making it essential to verify whether cost reductions and revenue contribution stem from the quality of the LLMs or from organisational capabilities in learning from LLMs. Based on the theories of information success, open innovation, and organisational learning, this paper examines how firms’ evaluations of LLM quality and their learning and innovation capabilities shape financial performance perceptions, which in turn drive increased utilisation of LLMs. A post-hoc experiment was conducted to reexamine the relationship between information quality and user satisfaction with LLMs. The survey sample consisted of 261 firm representatives (one key informant per firm). For the post-hoc experiment, 148 corporate employees with prior experience utilising LLM-based services were recruited. Evaluation of the measurement properties, structural model testing, and post-hoc analyses were performed using SPSS-29.0, PLS-SEM-4.1, and Lavaan package (v0.6-15). The results reveal a finding that challenges conventional assumptions about how information quality shapes user satisfaction in LLM contexts. This study aims to provide practical implications for firms seeking to strengthen the organisational foundations necessary for sustainable value creation through LLM adoption.

ur.tldr: 基于信息系统成功、开放式创新与组织学习理论，探究企业LLM应用中模型质量与学习创新能力如何共同影响财务绩效感知并进而促进使用增长。通过261家企业代表问卷与148名企业员工的补充实验，结合PLS-SEM与结构方程分析，发现信息质量对LLM用户满意度的作用机制有别于传统假设，强调组织学习与创新基础能力是LLM持续创造价值的关键，为企业推进可持续的LLM落地提供实践指引。

title: Integrating is success and open innovation in enterprise LLM adoption: a dual-path model of net benefits and usage growth
title_zh: 企业LLM采纳中整合信息系统成功与开放式创新:净收益与使用增长的双路径模型
